name: Gold Rush Tycoon
desc: v21: four huge two-storey bases around a central plaza. Claim ONE base and its armory opens EIGHT weapon cases — swords, blasters, ray guns, the spinning minigun — each one its own pad: see the weapon spinning inside its glass case, step on to buy it, step back on any time to re-equip. Sweep your vault, raid others (25%), follow the glowing pads.

lines: claim a base · step on pads to build
